instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler.
Add chicken and salt to a large saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 tbsp salt
12 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Turn heat down to medium and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a second large saucepan over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to second preheated pan.

Wash and dry bell pepper and jalapeno; Remove seeds and ribs with a spoon. Be careful, with jalapenos, not to touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 ½ jalapeño peppers

instructions.primary_message: Small dice all peppers and add to the pan.
Season with chili powder, cumin, and salt. Cook until vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Drain diced tomatoes; discard juice and add tomatoes to the pan.
Add yogurt, mayo, and flour to the pan, stirring to combine. Bring mixture to a boil and then reduce heat to minimum.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt

instructions.primary_message: When chicken is done, drain and shred with a fork. Add to vegetable and yogurt mixture.
To assemble, place two tortillas on the bottom of a large baking dish. Cover with half of the chicken mixture. Top with more tortillas and remainder of the chicken mixture.
Top with cheese. Broil for 3 minutes until cheese on top melts and becomes golden brown.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide the tortilla between plates, top with green onions, cilantro, and a drizzle of yogurt. Enjoy!
